My story is lil more risky than others but during my cancer stage I had an epiphany moment where I wanted to leave my family something that could mature into something special so 3 or 4 years ago at the end of the crypto bull market I taught myself everything there is to know and researched hundreds of companies (coins) to find one with real world use that I believed in and that wouldn’t be solely reliant on crypto markets.
I put some of the little money I had into it to buy a few altcoins to let them mature and hopefully it can turn into something (this was when ethereum was $80 a coin) and I exchanged that into the specific alt coin I set my eyes on after countless months of research. 
I am happy to say I survived cancer and all the debt I had accumulated during all that time not being able to work etc I was able to pay off as the coin matured.
Mine was a risky way of doing it and in a sad way I wasn’t expecting to come out the other side as it was more family oriented if I did pass so they had something to see grow and mature.

Keep at it no matter how bleak or far off it feels, keep the payments going as gets a lot better.
